title: How to use help assistant in Canva on Mac: steps, tips and fixes for 2026
metaTitle: How to Use Help Assistant in Canva on Mac (Step by Step)
description: How to use Help Assistant in Canva on Mac: open it from the editor, type a question, read the answer, then close it. Steps and fixes.
targetKeyword: how to use help assistant in canva
intro: To use Help Assistant in Canva on Mac, open it from the editor, the homepage or Settings, type your question, and read the answer. Use the Close button to dismiss it when you are done, then ask again whenever you get stuck.
tldr: Open Help Assistant from the editor, the homepage or Settings.
Type a plain question, read the answer, then make the change yourself.
Close the panel with the Close button. Your design stays as it was.
If it will not open, hard refresh with ⌘⇧R or try a private window, then check status.canva.com.
Hold ⌥⌘ and ask Lazur where the button is, and Lazur circles it for you.

blocks.text: Help Assistant is Canva's built-in question box. You type what you want to do, read the answer in a panel, and then make the change yourself. That split helps. You get the right feature name without digging through every menu, and you keep control of the design.
What you need before you start

You need a Canva account, signed in, and a working internet connection. Canva's Mac download page says the desktop app runs on Macs with Intel chips and Macs with Apple chips. A browser works too, so you can use whichever one you already open each day.

items: A Canva account, signed in on this Mac
A Mac with an Intel chip or an Apple chip, for the desktop app
Canva open in the desktop app or in a browser such as Safari or Chrome

blocks.text: Canva's Mac page does not show a minimum macOS version or a current app version number. Other sites disagree about which older macOS versions still work, so this page does not give one. Check your version under Apple menu > About This Mac, then compare it with Canva's requirements page before you install.
Open Help Assistant in the Canva editor

The editor is where most questions come up, so start there. In the desktop app, open a design from Home or from your recent list. In a browser, sign in at canva.com and open the design you want to change. Then look for the Help Assistant button.

Canva changes its layout from time to time, so do not rely on one fixed spot. Scan the edges of the window first. The bottom right corner is a common place to look. If you still cannot find it, use the Settings route covered below.
Open Help Assistant from the homepage or Settings

The homepage is the second entry point. Use it when no design is open and you want to know how something works. A question like how do I set up my brand colors? fits here better than a question about one design.

For Settings, open the Canva menu, then choose Settings. Look for Help or Help Assistant in the list. If you cannot find it, type Help into the Settings search box. Labels shift between versions, so the wording on your screen may not match this page exactly.
How to ask Help Assistant a good question
Ask about a goal, not a button. How do I line up three photos evenly? gets you further than what is the blue icon? Name the thing you are working on, and describe the result you want.

items: Vague: how do I make it look better?
Better: how do I line up three photos evenly across the page?
Better: why does my PDF download fail, and what should I try first?
Better: how do I resize a logo for an Instagram post?

blocks.text: Keep each question to one task. Two tasks in one question often give a muddy answer. Ask the first, follow it, then ask the second. Short, separate questions get clearer answers than one long list.
Common mistakes when you use Help Assistant

The most common mistake is expecting Help Assistant to change the design. It answers, and you act. Read the answer, then do each step in order. If a step names a menu you cannot find, say so in your next question instead of guessing.
The second mistake is asking about another app. Keep questions about Canva. For Photoshop or Figma, use that app's own help, or ask Lazur on screen while you work there.
The third mistake is closing the panel too soon. Long answers can run past the bottom of the panel. Scroll to the end first, then close it.
Close Help Assistant and reopen it

Click Close to dismiss the panel. Closing it hides the answer and leaves your design as it was. If you need the steps later, copy them into a note before you close the panel. You can ask the question again at any time.
When Help Assistant will not open

Sometimes the panel does not open, or the editor sits on a blank screen or an endless spinner. Start with the cheapest fixes. Open the design in a private window to rule out browser extensions, especially ad blockers. Then try a second browser.

items: Hard refresh the editor with ⌘⇧R in the browser.
Open a private window and load canva.com again.
Turn off ad blockers for canva.com, then reload.
Check status.canva.com for an outage before you retry.
Try a second browser such as Safari or Chrome.

blocks.text: Login loops need a different fix. If Canva keeps sending you back to the sign in page, clear only the canva.com cookies. Do not clear your whole browser cache. If that fails, try another browser. Clearing everything takes longer than you need.

Exports are a separate problem. If a download fails, check status.canva.com, export as PNG instead of PDF, or hard refresh before you try again. Export outages usually resolve within one to three hours, according to a May 2026 troubleshooting guide. Wait before you retry if the status page shows a problem.
School and Education accounts

Your account may behave differently if you use Canva through a school. Reports say student accounts may get help limited to Canva questions unless a Canva Education admin turns on design help. If Help Assistant is missing on a school account, ask your admin before you spend time on fixes.
A worked example from start to finish

Say you are making a flyer, and the PDF download keeps failing. Open the design in the editor. Find the Help Assistant button, open the panel, and type your question: why does my PDF download fail, and what should I try first?

Read the answer and follow its first step. If it says to export as PNG, do that and check the file. If the export still fails, check status.canva.com before you retry. Write down what you tried, so you can tell Canva support exactly what happened.
Using Lazur with Help Assistant on your Mac

Lazur is a voice assistant that lives in the notch of your Mac. Hold Option and Command together to ask about anything on screen. Lazur sees your screen, answers out loud, and points at things. Ask where something is, and Lazur draws a circle and a label around it.

This helps most when you cannot find the Help Assistant button. Hold ⌥⌘ and ask, where is the Help Assistant button? Lazur circles it on your screen. You still click it yourself, because Lazur does not click buttons or operate Canva for you.

For a longer job, ask Lazur to walk you through it. Lazur guides you one click at a time and waits for each click before it moves on. That suits a feature you are learning for the first time, when you want to go slowly and check each step.

Lazur listens and looks at the screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot go to AI providers so Lazur can answer, and they are not stored. Content is never used to train AI models. Check that against your client's confidentiality rules before you use it on client work.
Check the answer against Canva's help

blocks.title: Menu names may differ
blocks.text: The menu names on this page were not checked against a live Canva screen, because Canva's help pages could not be opened. If your screen shows different labels, follow your screen and check Canva's help center.

Help Assistant gives a fast answer. Canva's own help center is the final word. When an answer does not match what you see, trust your screen and look for the same feature in Settings or in the help center.
What to do next

Try one real question on a blank test design before you use it on a client file. If you open Canva every day, the Dock guide saves time. Read [how to open Canva files from the Dock](/how-to/open-designs-from-the-dock-in-canva) when you are ready.
If the desktop app misbehaves after that, read the [reset guide](/how-to/reset-the-desktop-app-in-canva) before you delete anything. For Lazur inside Canva, see [Lazur for Canva on Mac](/apps/canva).

faq.question: Where is Help Assistant in Canva on Mac?
faq.answer: Canva's help content describes three starting points: the homepage, the editor, and Settings. Start in the editor, since most questions come up while you work on a design. If you cannot see it there, try Settings.

faq.question: Do I need the desktop app to use Help Assistant?
faq.answer: This page could not confirm any difference between the Mac app and the browser editor. Use whichever you open each day, and compare the labels if a step does not match your screen.

faq.question: Can Help Assistant change my design for me?
faq.answer: Based on the help content checked for this page, Help Assistant answers questions and you make the change. Ask Lazur to point at a button or walk you through a step if you want a guide on screen.

faq.question: Which macOS version do I need for Canva?
faq.answer: Canva's Mac download page lists Intel and Apple chips, but it does not show a minimum macOS version. Check Canva's requirements page before you install or update.

faq.question: Can Lazur open Help Assistant for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons for you. Hold Option and Command, ask where the button is, and Lazur circles it. Ask Lazur to guide you, and it waits for each click.

faq.question: What shortcut fixes a stuck Canva editor?
faq.answer: In a browser, ⌘⇧R does a hard refresh. Try it before you clear any cookies. If the editor still fails, check status.canva.com and try a second browser.

steps.name: Open the design you want help with
steps.text: In the desktop app, open a design from Home or from the recent list. In a browser, sign in at canva.com and open the design. Help Assistant works best while you are looking at the page you want to change.

steps.name: Find the Help Assistant button
steps.text: Scan the edges of the editor window, starting with the bottom right corner. Look for a button labeled Help or Help Assistant. Canva changes its layout, so the position may differ from what you remember.
steps.tip: If you cannot see it, use the Settings route in the next steps.

steps.name: Open the panel and type your question
steps.text: Click the Help Assistant button. In the panel, type your question in plain words, then press Return. Name the page, element or export type you care about.

steps.name: Read the answer and follow it yourself
steps.text: Read the whole answer before you act. Then do each step in the design, in order. Help Assistant explains the steps, and you make the change. Stop if a menu name does not match, and ask again with the name you see.
steps.tip: Copy the steps into a note if you want to keep them.

steps.name: Close the panel
steps.text: Click Close to dismiss Help Assistant. The panel hides the answer, and your design stays as it was. Reopen it any time from the same button.

steps.name: Find it in Settings if the editor button is missing
steps.text: Open the Canva menu and choose Settings. Look for Help or Help Assistant. If you do not see it, type Help in the Settings search box. Canva's labels can change, so the wording may differ on your version.
steps.tip: Use the search box in Settings rather than scrolling the whole list.

steps.name: Hard refresh a browser editor that will not load
steps.text: If the editor sits on a blank screen or spins forever, hard refresh the page. This applies to the browser editor. If the problem stays, open a private window and load canva.com again.

shortcuts.action: Hard refresh the Canva editor in a browser

troubleshooting.problem: Help Assistant button is missing in the editor
troubleshooting.fix: Scan the edges of the window, then open Settings and search for Help. If a school account blocks it, ask your Canva Education admin.

troubleshooting.problem: Editor shows a blank screen or an endless spinner
troubleshooting.fix: Open a private window, turn off ad blockers for canva.com, then check status.canva.com. Try another browser if it still fails.

troubleshooting.problem: Login loop keeps sending you back to sign in
troubleshooting.fix: Clear only the canva.com cookies, not the whole browser cache. Try another browser if that fails.

troubleshooting.problem: Export fails and the download never finishes
troubleshooting.fix: Check status.canva.com, export as PNG instead of PDF, or hard refresh with ⌘⇧R before you try again. Outages usually resolve within one to three hours.
